title: A GripForge scene file (<name>.gfscene)
description: A scene of a GripForge project: a tree of typed nodes, its sub-scenes, the kits' sections, its bindings. JSON, owned by the game, without a version field: read with tolerance (docs/dev-builder.md, docs/ecrire-un-projet.md).

on.description: The bindings of the scene itself: entered, left, event.

meta.description: Free, for the editor; never read by a kit.

requires.description: The kits this whole file needs (never per node). Not an installation: a missing kit refuses the scene with what to install; the build, the CLI and the MCP read it to propose the kits.

binding.description: Interactivity without code: when something happens, run game.engine verbs.

when.description: enter/leave: a trigger; interact: a model or shape; entered/left: the scene (its own on); event: a named event (event).

event.description: The event that runs the binding, with when: event.

do.description: game.engine verbs: emit, call, set_var, inc_var, load_scene, push_scene, show, hide... A verb's "on" may name a node by path (../Crate).

sections.description: The sections of the kits, by kit id: what each kit reads or places on this node or scene (declared by its expose entries for scene).

props_model.description: A 3D model file of the project, given to game.engine as an instance (its archetype, or one made from these properties).

asset.description: Path of the model file in the project (models/crate.glb); its passport in asset.meta stays its identity.

material.description: A material name of the game, or { color, metallic, roughness, ... } laid over the file's materials.

props_shape.description: A simple shape drawn natively by each engine, given to game.engine as an instance.

size.description: box: [x, y, z] or one number; plane: [x, z].

tube.description: torus: the radius of the tube.

material.description: A material name of the game, or { color, metallic, roughness, ... }.

props_light.description: A light declared by the game, placed by dev.builder through core.light (adopted at its path in the engine's tree, else made there).

kind.description: The kind of light; a directional light shines along its -Z axis.

intensity.description: In the units of core.light, which places the light: lux for a directional light, lumens for a point or spot light; unset: core.light's default for the kind.

range.description: point and spot: the distance where the light ends, in metres.

angle.description: spot: the outer angle of the cone, in degrees.

props_camera.description: A camera of the scene, placed by dev.builder through core.camera (adopted at its path, else made), with the fixed preset looking along its -Z axis.

fov.description: The vertical field of view, in degrees.

current.description: Whether this camera draws when the scene is entered.

props_trigger.description: A trigger zone (game.engine zones): bindings run when something enters or leaves it.

watch.description: The tags of the entities the zone watches (empty: the player).

props_sound.description: A sound of the scene, played by the sound kit when there is one.

asset.description: Path of the sound file in the project.

spatial.description: A 3D voice placed at the node.

props_hud.description: A HUD slot of core.webui (<kit>/<slot>) and the HUD asset it shows.

asset.description: Path of the HUD asset package in the project; empty: the asset the kit recommends.

props.description: The properties given to the asset.

node.description: A node of the scene. Unknown keys are kept and reported; a value that does not fit warns and takes its default, never an error.

name.description: Unique among its siblings: the link of the node's path (Hall/Door).

id.description: Optional stable identifier, unique in the scene: it survives renames and moves, a binding, an override or a command may name the node by it, and it is the id game.engine receives (prefixed by the instance node inside a sub-scene).

position.description: Metres, relative to the parent; right-handed, +Y up.

rotation.description: By default Euler angles in degrees [x, y, z], applied Y, X, Z (yaw, pitch, roll), relative to the parent; a quaternion { x, y, z, w } is accepted too.

scale.description: Per axis, or one number for all three.

visible.description: Hidden with its children when false.

overrides.description: scene nodes: { "<path in the sub-scene>": { <keys to merge> } }; name and children cannot be overridden.

scene.description: scene nodes: the path of the instanced scene file (`<name>.gfscene`) in the project.

entity.description: The entity of the element (docs/entites-et-rendu.md, the writing of game.engine): its states (kept in the game.engine entity, or derived) and the render values bound to a state. A node with states counts for the game: it gets an entity (a group too: a light entity holding the states), and it can be used (on: interact).

states.description: The states, as a game.engine archetype declares them (given to it as written): { values, default? } (an enumeration, default the first), { default } (a stored value) or { derived: { var | component | expr | hook } } (computed, never stored).

bind.description: Render values of nodes of the element's subtree that follow a number state, after the rules (game.engine's bind, plus node).

reflect.description: The table state → reflection (game.engine's reflect, per node of the subtree): rules that act on any node of the element's subtree (its children: models, sounds, lights, particles, HUD slots, sub-scenes), resolved by game.engine's resolver and posed by dev.builder in the engine's tree. What has no way yet (a model change, a clip, a sound, spin, on, the tween of a transition) is listed in dev.builder.reflect's pending.

bind.description: Which values of the render the entity drives (position, yaw), property by property: bound, an edit changes the entity and the render follows; free, the value is the render's own. Default: position bound, rotation and scale free. A render value that follows a state goes in entity.bind of its element.

position.description: The node's position ↔ the entity's x, y, z; null: free.

yaw.description: The node's heading (its -Z axis around Y) ↔ the entity's yaw; null (the default): free.

quat.description: A rotation as a unit quaternion { x, y, z, w } (the form of the editor and of the site's commands); normalised when read.

state.description: A state of the element besides its default one (the first, « no change », which every entity has), written as a game.engine archetype declares it: an enumeration (values, default), a stored value (default), or derived, never stored (derived).

default.description: The value when the game has not set it; the first of values when left out.

values.description: The enumeration of the values (a bool is [false, true]).

derived.description: Computed from one source, never stored, saved nor synchronized (its source is): var (a game variable path), component (a component of the entity, or { name, field }), expr ({ var, op?, value? }, { all }, { any }, { not }, a constant), hook (true: game.engine's hook engine.state.derive answers).

state_bind.description: A render value bound to a number state (game.engine's bind, plus node).

node.description: The path of the node under the element; empty or left out: the element itself.

property.description: Degrees for a rotation axis, a factor for a scale, metres for an offset; laid under the node's pose in the file.

from.description: The state it follows (declared in entity.states).

reflect_rule.description: A rule of the reflection (game.engine's): when the states match (partial: only the states named, one value each; empty: always), set the given properties on nodes of the element's subtree. Every matching rule applies, in order: a later one wins on the same property.

set.description: { <path relative to the element, "" the element itself>: { visible, rotation, scale, offset, material, anim, slot, shape, morphs, fade, light, play, playing, spin, on } }: game.engine's fields (a pose laid under the node's pose in the file, as game.engine lays a rule under a root's base pose: rotation in degrees, scale, offset in metres), plus the props of that node's type, play (a sound once), playing (a sound in a loop), spin ({ rpm, clockwise }: a turn that never stops), on (bindings active).

transition.description: Optional: { duration (s, 0 to 60), ease, play (a sound at its start) }, played at the render, never at the first reflection.

play.description: The sound node played at its start.
